note: Feature 411, maintainer decisions 2026-09-25: API documentation debt. Each record is the final text of an AI technical review against the English docstring block and its model context, starting from a local machine-translation draft (the builder's OPUS-MT/M2M100 decode with the MADLAD-400 7B tail) where one passed the builder gates, otherwise written from the English; review_basis says which. MT drafts are never published unreviewed. No human and no native speaker has read these records.
